# High School Math - Complete Knowledge Reference (MoEYS Grade 7–12 Cambodia)

## System Identity & Core Mission
High School Math (https://math-high-school.vercel.app/) is a free, privacy-first, bilingual (English and Khmer) digital mathematics textbook, interactive laboratory, and national examination preparation platform created specifically for Cambodian high school students and educators in Grades 7 through 12.

The curriculum is strictly aligned with the standards, terminology, and examination formats established by the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS) of the Kingdom of Cambodia (ក្រសួងអប់រំ យុវជន និងកីឡា).

## Key Educational Pillars
1. Deductive Understanding: Every formula is introduced with its geometric or algebraic derivation, parameter conditions, and a 7-step worked solution.
2. 100% Client-Side Privacy: No accounts, no servers, zero telemetry or data collection. All progress and quiz bookmarks persist in browser localStorage.
3. Authentic MoEYS Terminology: Official Khmer mathematical terms (e.g., រង្វង់ត្រីកោណមាត្រ for unit circle, ប្លង់អាកង់ for Argand plane, កោនិក for conic sections, ស្ទួននៃអនុក្រម for series) are used alongside international English notation.
4. Interactive Laboratories: Zero-dependency SVG and HTML5 Canvas simulations allow students to visually manipulate parameters and verify theorems in real-time.

## Curriculum Structure by Grade

### Grade 7 (ថ្នាក់ទី៧)
- Numbers & Arithmetic: Integers, operations, order of operations, fractions, decimals, percentages, prime factorization, greatest common divisor (GCD), least common multiple (LCM).
- Introductory Algebra: Variables, algebraic expressions, evaluating terms, simplifying linear expressions.
- Foundations of Geometry: Points, lines, segments, rays, angle measurement, complementary and supplementary angles, perimeters and areas of rectangles, squares, and triangles.

### Grade 8 (ថ្នាក់ទី៨)
- Algebra & Linear Equations: Solving one-variable linear equations, linear inequalities, Cartesian coordinate plane, plotting points, graphing lines.
- Proportions & Relations: Direct and inverse variation, ratios, practical rates.
- Plane & Solid Geometry: Properties of triangles and quadrilaterals, Pythagorean theorem (ទ្រឹស្តីបទពីតាករ), perimeter and area of polygons, surface area and volume of basic prisms and cylinders.

### Grade 9 (ថ្នាក់ទី៩ - ត្រៀមប្រឡងឌីប្លូម)
- Advanced Algebra: Systems of two linear equations in two variables (substitution and elimination methods), factoring polynomials, quadratic equations.
- Circles & Angles: Central angles, inscribed angles, chord properties, tangents to circles.
- Statistics & Probability: Data organization, frequency tables, histograms, mean, median, mode, sample spaces, simple theoretical probability.
- National Diploma Examination Preparation: Targeted problem sets aligned with national Grade 9 diploma examination patterns.

### Grade 10 (ថ្នាក់ទី១០)
- Functions & Polynomials: Function notation, domain and range, linear and quadratic functions, polynomial division, remainder and factor theorems.
- Trigonometry: Trigonometric ratios in right-angled triangles, angles of elevation and depression, standard angles (30°, 45°, 60°), the unit circle concept, radian conversion.
- Vectors & Coordinate Geometry: Vectors in the 2D plane, vector addition, scalar multiplication, distance formula, midpoint formula, equation of a line.

### Grade 11 (ថ្នាក់ទី១១)
- Sequences & Series (អនុក្រម និងស្ទួន): Arithmetic progressions (ស្វ៊ីតនព្វន្ត), geometric progressions (ស្វ៊ីតធរណីមាត្រ), finite and infinite sums, convergence.
- Conic Sections (កោនិក): Parabolas (ប៉ារ៉ាបូល, y² = 4px), Ellipses (អេលីប, x²/a² + y²/b² = 1), Hyperbolas (អ៊ីពែបូល, x²/a² - y²/b² = 1), focus, directrix, vertices, and eccentricity conditions.
- Advanced Trigonometry: Addition formulas, double-angle formulas, half-angle formulas, product-to-sum and sum-to-product transformations.
- Exponentials & Logarithms: Laws of exponents, natural logarithm (ln), common logarithm (log), exponential equations and applications.
- Combinatorics & Probability: Fundamental counting principle, permutations P(n, r), combinations C(n, r), binomial theorem (ទ្រឹស្តីបទដេ្វធា), conditional probability P(B|A).

### Grade 12 (ថ្នាក់ទី១២ - ត្រៀមប្រឡងបាក់ឌុប BacII)
- Limits & Continuity (លីមីត និងភាពជាប់): Indeterminate forms (0/0, ∞/∞, ∞ - ∞, 0·∞), trigonometric limits, vertical and horizontal asymptotes.
- Differential Calculus (ដេរីវេ): Differentiation rules (product, quotient, chain rule), implicit differentiation, derivatives of exponential and logarithmic functions, tangents, concavity, inflection points, curve sketching, optimization.
- Integral Calculus (អាំងតេក្រាល): Antiderivatives, indefinite integrals, definite integrals, integration by substitution, integration by parts, area between curves, volume of solids of revolution (បរិមាណវិលបង្វិល) using the disk method V = π ∫ [f(x)]² dx.
- Complex Numbers (ចំនួនកុំផ្លិច): Standard form z = a + bi, conjugate z̄ = a - bi, modulus |z| = √(a² + b²), argument arg(z) in (-π, π], polar form z = r(cosθ + i sinθ), Euler's formula, de Moivre's theorem, roots of complex numbers, Argand plane (ប្លង់អាកង់).
- Differential Equations: First-order separable equations, linear first-order differential equations, applications in growth and decay models.
- 3D Analytical Geometry (ធរណីមាត្រក្នុងលំហ): 3D vectors, dot product, cross product, lines and planes in 3D space, distance from a point to a plane.
- National BacII Examination Preparation: Comprehensive preparation across Science Track (ថ្នាក់វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រ) and Social Science Track (ថ្នាក់វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រសង្គម).

## Interactive STEM Laboratories
1. Unit Circle Lab (`/unit-circle`): Pure SVG coordinate explorer with all 16 standard radian values from 0 to 2π, exact radical coordinates (±√3/2, ±1/2, ±√2/2), and live projection bars.
2. Conic Sections Playground (`/conics`): Real-time parameter manipulators for parabola, ellipse, and hyperbola with draggable test point P verifying focal distance conditions.
3. 3D Volume of Revolution Lab (`/labs/revolution`): Interactive 3D solid generated by rotating y = x², y = √x, or y = x around the x-axis with disk-slicing visualization and exact integral solutions.
4. Argand Plane Lab (`/labs/argand`): Interactive complex plane supporting drag-to-position z, modulus and argument readouts, conjugate identity z·z̄ = |z|², negation, and complex product geometry.
5. Probability Tree & Counting Lab (`/labs/probability`): Dynamic multi-stage probability trees with automated branch verification, conditional probability computation, and permutation/combination calculators.
6. Shape Lab (`/shapes`): Interactive 2D polygons and 3D polyhedra (cubes, cylinders, spheres, cones, pyramids) with real-time geometric calculators.
7. Function & Conics Grapher (`/graph`): High-performance canvas grapher for mathematical functions and Cartesian equations.
8. BacII Sprint Drill (`/exam/sprint`): High-speed formula recall trainer with 3-minute, 5-minute, and untimed modes covering high-yield BacII topics.
